objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy, guideline, instruction or other document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, translated or reactivated.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation such as a type abbreviation and consecutive number.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document state such as editing, released or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which a released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from valid from and the period of extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an invalidated document is archived.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a document and used to define templates, validity period and archive duration.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after release after which validity must be checked.

objs.name: template
objs.description: Template selectable for a document type when creating a new document.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized or customer-specific document properties maintained in categories.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled dependent document released with the main document and subject to versioning and archiving.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary information for a document that is released and published directly through properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document that can be created and managed without affecting document content or version history.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a document to declare it out of force and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader or initiator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, reader access, distribution, archive access or business administration.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of users and user groups maintained for a document for e-mail distribution, acknowledgement and dashboards.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Workflow-supported task assigned to participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation or acknowledgement.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature used by workflow participants to complete release-related tasks.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation of acknowledgement requested from distribution recipients.

objs.name: translation
objs.description: Language-dependent translated version of released document content.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attachment of a new information object and selection of a document type.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit the document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is changed or revised.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark a released attachment for archiving.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an attachment with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, metadata and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs creation in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes the release step positively to finally release a document.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject a review or release task, causing workflow cancellation for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish a released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update the valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or override is declared.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document out of force, keep the request for documentation, delete edited versions and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive invalidated documents and attachments by withdrawing authorizations.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation in the workflow step for the request initiator.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an invalidated document and restore metadata, properties, authorizations and distribution list entries.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign users and user groups to the distribution list of a document.

evts.name: notify_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail notification.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement by e-mail upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement in a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated version so it is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: set_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.
